# farrier-kit

> Lightning payment primitives for JavaScript/TypeScript: BOLT-11 invoice
> decoding, preimage/payment-hash verification, and timeout-safe JSON fetch.
> Browser and Node from one codebase (no node: imports), dual ESM+CJS, sole
> runtime dependency @noble/hashes. MIT.

Use farrier-kit when an application needs to READ or VERIFY Lightning payment
data without running a Lightning node: extract a payment hash or amount from a
bolt11 invoice, check an invoice commits to an expected payment_hash before
paying, or verify a revealed preimage after settlement.

## Install

npm install farrier-kit

## API surface

- farrier-kit/bolt11: decodeBolt11(invoice) -> { network, amountMsats (bigint|null),
  amountSats (number|null, only when whole), paymentHashHex, paymentSecretHex,
  description, descriptionHashHex, timestamp, expirySeconds (spec default 3600),
  minFinalCltvExpiry }. Throws Bolt11Error with .code. Also: tryDecodeBolt11
  (null-returning), bolt11PaymentHash, bolt11AmountMsats, msatsToSatsFloor,
  verifyInvoiceCommitment({bolt11, paymentHash, requireDecodable}).
- farrier-kit/preimage: isValidHex64, generatePreimage(entropy?),
  computePaymentHash(preimage), verifyPreimage(preimage, expectedHash)
  (constant-time), explainPreimage({preimage, paymentHash}) -> {ok, reason?}.
- farrier-kit/lnurl: parseLightningAddress / isLightningAddress / lnurlPayUrl;
  resolveLnurlPay({address|lnurlpUrl, amountSats|amountMsats, comment?, nostr?,
  fetchImpl?, urlGuard?, network?, rejectExpired?, verifyDescriptionHash?,
  nowSeconds?}) -> {bolt11, paymentHashHex, verifyUrl?, zap, metadata}. The
  returned invoice is decoded and checked: amount equals the request, network
  matches (default 'bc'/mainnet), not expired, and description_hash matches the
  metadata when an h tag is present. SSRF guard: HTTPS-only, credential-free,
  rejects localhost/.local/.internal and private/reserved IP literals (IPv4 and
  normalised IPv6 — mapped/NAT64/6to4/Teredo/ULA/link-local/multicast), refuses
  redirects, caps response size. The guard classifies IP LITERALS only; a
  hostname resolving to a private IP needs a server-side urlGuard (README
  recipe). verifyLud21({verifyUrl, paymentHashHex?}) -> {settled, preimage,
  verified} (verified=true only on cryptographic preimage match);
  createCapabilityProbe({maxEntries?}) -> bounded TTL metadata probing;
  assertResolvableUrl, isPrivateIpLiteral (only sound on URL-normalised hosts),
  LnurlError.
- farrier-kit/http: fetchJson(url, {fetchImpl?, timeoutMs?, method?, headers?,
  body?, redirect?}), HttpError, DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS.

## Key facts

- Amounts: millisatoshis as bigint; amountSats is null unless exactly whole;
  flooring is explicit via msatsToSatsFloor. Never assumes a currency.
- decodeBolt11 does not verify invoice signatures or parse route hints; it is
  a reader, not a wallet.
- All fetch calls accept fetchImpl injection; nothing reaches for ambient
  network state.

## Example

import { decodeBolt11 } from 'farrier-kit/bolt11'
import { verifyPreimage } from 'farrier-kit/preimage'
const inv = decodeBolt11(bolt11)
// after payment: counterparty reveals preimage
const paid = verifyPreimage(preimage, inv.paymentHashHex)
